onboardingChallenge.title: 21-Day Rescue Tutorial
onboardingChallenge.subtitle: Stabilize your promotion before momentum collapses.
onboardingChallenge.cashProgressNote: Uses daily operating income and costs; excludes one-time spending such as hiring and event bookings.
onboardingChallenge.deadline: {{days}} days left to complete all objectives.
onboardingChallenge.rewardHint: Complete all objectives for +${{cash}} cash and +{{prestige}} prestige.
onboardingChallenge.successSummary: Challenge complete. Reward granted: +${{cash}} cash and +{{prestige}} prestige.
onboardingChallenge.failSummary: Challenge failed. Penalty applied: {{fans}} fans and {{prestige}} prestige.

objectives.stabilize: Keep operating cash flow at break-even or better

buildRoster.title: Build an event-ready roster
buildRoster.body: Hire 12 wrestlers, at least one staff member, a referee, and an announcer. Use the employee role filters and check contract costs before signing.

openingShow.title: Book and run your opening show
openingShow.body: Open Event Planning, confirm the weekly show, build a balanced card with matches and a promo, then run it when the roster requirements are met.

secondShow.title: Build on the first crowd reaction
secondShow.body: Plan a second weekly card. Try a different stipulation or main-event pairing and compare attendance and ratings after the show.

finalShow.title: Deliver the final rescue show
finalShow.body: Run a third successful weekly show. Review its event results, attendance segments, and postmortem for clues about what to improve.

stabilizePromotion.title: Stabilize the promotion
stabilizePromotion.body: Review operating income, payroll, and recurring costs. Finish with at least 350 additional fans and non-negative operating cash flow.

completed.title: Rescue tutorial complete
completed.body: Your promotion has completed the three-show rescue and stabilization plan. Keep using event results and finances to guide your next goals.

failed.title: Rescue tutorial ended
failed.body: The 21-day rescue window has closed. Review your roster and operating cash flow, then use the next campaign to recover.

gameOver.title: The Board Has Dismissed You

gameOver.relation: Board Relation fell into the dismissal range, and the Board voted to remove you as General Manager.

boardElection.title: Annual President & Vice President Election
boardElection.description: Choose your presidential nominee. The board will elect its President and Vice President for the coming year.

financialReview.title: Financial Review
financialReview.description: The Audit Committee is concerned about the recent operating loss.

sponsorReview.title: Sponsor Proposal
sponsorReview.description: A board member has brought a sponsor proposal to the meeting.

eventReview.title: Event Review
eventReview.description: Discuss the latest results and the next event's budget.

championChange.title: Champion Change
championChange.description: The Board has a preferred challenger for an active championship.

wrestlerPush.title: Talent Spotlight
wrestlerPush.description: The Compensation Committee wants a wrestler featured on the next card.

eventRatingTarget.title: Event Rating Mandate
eventRatingTarget.description: The Board wants management to commit to a rating target.

mandateReview.title: Mandate Review
mandateReview.description: The Board is reviewing previous commitments.

investmentProposal.title: Marketing Investment
investmentProposal.description: The Board is considering a new audience-growth campaign.

competitorResponse.title: Competitor Response
competitorResponse.description: The Board wants to decide how aggressively to respond to rivals.

promotionStrategy.title: Long-Term Strategy
promotionStrategy.description: The Vice Chair wants to confirm the promotion's strategic direction.

presentRecoveryPlan.label: Present a recovery plan
presentRecoveryPlan.description: Commit to positive operating cash flow by the next Board Meeting.

enactCostControls.label: Accept temporary cost controls
enactCostControls.description: Reduce daily operating costs for the next 30 game days.

rejectPressure.label: Reject the Board's pressure
rejectPressure.description: Refuse to change course, at a significant cost to Board Relation.

acceptSponsorProposal.label: Accept and sign the sponsor
acceptSponsorProposal.description: Sign the proposed contract and receive its stated terms.

rejectSponsorProposal.label: Reject the sponsor
rejectSponsorProposal.description: Keep the current sponsor strategy, disappointing the proposer.

releaseUnderperformingSponsor.label: End the lowest-trust sponsor contract
releaseUnderperformingSponsor.description: Remove the sponsor the Board is concerned about.

investInEvent.label: Invest in the next event
investInEvent.description: Spend $5,000 on promotion to increase audience growth.

protectEventBudget.label: Protect the event budget
protectEventBudget.description: Avoid new event spending and preserve cash.

approveChampionChange.label: Approve the champion change
approveChampionChange.description: Install the Board's chosen wrestler as champion.

rejectChampionChange.label: Reject the champion change
rejectChampionChange.description: Keep the current champion and risk friction with the Board.

acceptWrestlerPush.label: Accept the push request
acceptWrestlerPush.description: Feature the wrestler in at least one event before the deadline.

declineWrestlerPush.label: Decline the push request
declineWrestlerPush.description: Keep booking freedom, but disappoint the Compensation Committee.

acceptEventRatingTarget.label: Commit to the target
acceptEventRatingTarget.description: Meet the event rating target or lose Board Relation.

declineEventRatingTarget.label: Decline the target
declineEventRatingTarget.description: Avoid a performance mandate, at a cost to Board Relation.

reaffirmBoardMandates.label: Reaffirm the commitments
reaffirmBoardMandates.description: Keep the existing targets and reassure the Board.

extendBoardMandates.label: Request two more weeks
extendBoardMandates.description: Extend all active mandate deadlines by 14 game days.

cancelBoardMandates.label: Abandon the commitments
cancelBoardMandates.description: Cancel all active mandates and lose Board Relation.

approveMarketingInvestment.label: Approve the marketing campaign
approveMarketingInvestment.description: Spend $10,000 to grow the audience and show the Board's support.

deferMarketingInvestment.label: Defer the campaign
deferMarketingInvestment.description: Preserve cash now and revisit marketing later.

counterCompetitorPromotion.label: Fund a competitor response
counterCompetitorPromotion.description: Spend $5,000 on a short-term response and gain prestige.

holdCurrentStrategy.label: Hold the current strategy
holdCurrentStrategy.description: Avoid new spending and keep the current plan.

commitToLongTermGrowth.label: Commit to long-term growth
commitToLongTermGrowth.description: Support a growth-oriented strategy and improve Board Relation.

keepCurrentDirection.label: Keep the current direction
keepCurrentDirection.description: Make no strategic change this month.
